correctness.rationale: The proof constructs all primitive square-zero matrices as one orbit and counts them exactly; character evaluation by the unit Ramanujan sum gives p^k(Z_k-Z_{k-1}) and the exact content reduction. For primitive quadratics, discriminant classes and Hensel lifting give each value, including singular boundary cases. The discriminant map is smooth over the p-adic double-root locus, giving precise multiplicities; additive Fourier diagonalization gives rank. The standalone checker exhaustively compares multiset counts for (3,2), (3,3), (5,2), and directly evaluates Fourier sums on additional levels. These finite checks corroborate the proved infinite statement but are not used as its proof.

value.rationale: A complete character spectrum for the canonical primitive nilpotent conjugacy orbit over every odd prime-power ring determines convolution rank, nilpotent graph adjacency levels, exact frequency multiplicities and striking depth-dependent Fourier sparsity. At k=2 exactly 1-1/p of all eigenvalues vanish, while the nonzero Fourier fraction decreases as p^{-k} for fixed p. This is a motivated infinite structural classification, not a recoding of a field identity or a narrow numerical example.
